featured_reviews.name: maryam faridi
featured_reviews.review_text:
This brand is extremely disappointing and not customer-friendly at all. Their policies feel overly focused on making money rather than supporting customers. The sizing is highly inconsistent—kurtas and pants don’t follow any reliable standard, so you simply can’t trust what you’re ordering.
On top of that, they charge for returns and exchanges, and instead of refunding your money, they issue coupons—essentially holding your money hostage. Their claim of “hassle-free returns and exchanges” is misleading; the entire process is complicated, frustrating, and full of unnecessary hurdles.
Overall, the products are expensive and not worth the trouble. It feels like a trap where customers end up losing money. This kind of approach only leads to dissatisfaction and distrust. I would strongly advise others to avoid buying from them.
